SELECT g.*, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT p.season,p.league_id,p.source_digest,p.retrieved_at,(SELECT json_object_agg(metric_key,value) FROM statarena_app.partition_counts c WHERE c.season=p.season AND c.league_id=p.league_id) AS counts FROM statarena_app.partitions p ORDER BY p.season DESC,p.league_id) r) partitions,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.*,(SELECT json_agg(native_season ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.competition_catalog_seasons k WHERE k.competition_id=c.id) catalog_seasons FROM statarena_app.competitions c ORDER BY name,id) r) competitions,
 (SELECT json_object_agg(id,country) FROM statarena_app.teams WHERE country IS NOT NULL) countries FROM (SELECT generation::text AS version, published_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs) AS dirty FROM statarena_app.publications WHERE singleton) g

SELECT g.*,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE league_id=ANY($1::text[]) AND (season=ANY($2::text[]) OR native_season=ANY($2::text[])) ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT $3) r) AS rows FROM (SELECT generation::text AS version, published_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs) AS dirty FROM statarena_app.publications WHERE singleton) g

sql.sql:
WITH candidates AS (
 (SELECT f.id,f.day FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.season=$1 AND f.league_id=$2  ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))
 UNION ALL (SELECT m.id,m.day FROM statarena_app.matches m WHERE m.season=$1 AND m.league_id=$2 
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.id=m.id AND f.season=m.season AND f.league_id=m.league_id)
 ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))),
 keys AS (SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT ($3::int+1)), page AS (SELECT id FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT $3),
 page_appearances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.*,p.name,p.image_url,s.value_text AS shirt_number_raw,s.value_type AS shirt_number_type
 FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.players p ON p.id=a.player_ref
 LEFT JOIN statarena_app.appearance_shirt_numbers s ON s.appearance_id=a.id
 WHERE a.match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page)),
 appearance_extras AS (
 SELECT e.appearance_id,json_object_agg(e.metric_key,e.value ORDER BY e.metric_key) extras
 FROM statarena_app.appearance_metrics e JOIN page_appearances a ON a.id=e.appearance_id GROUP BY e.appearance_id)
 SELECT s.*, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,day::text FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id) r) keys,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.* FROM statarena_app.matches m JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id) r) matches,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT f.* FROM statarena_app.fixtures f JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id) r) fixtures,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(CASE WHEN (
  SELECT array_agg(attname ORDER BY attnum) = ARRAY['id','player_ref','ordinal','position_id_type','player_id','team_id','team','match_id','league_id','league','country','season','date','role','position_id','raw_pitch_x','raw_pitch_y','shirt_number','minutes','rating','goals','assists','xg','npxg','xa','xgot','shots','shots_on_target','chances_created','big_chances_created','passes_accurate','defensive_actions','interceptions','tackles','recoveries','duels_won','duels_lost','touches','touches_box','passes_final_third','clearances','blocks','dribbles','saves','goals_prevented','shots_off_target','blocked_shots','shots_woodwork','shot_accuracy','big_chances_missed','xg_plus_xa','long_balls_accurate','line_breaking_passes','accurate_crosses','corners','throws','offsides','dispossessed','dribbled_past','headed_clearances','aerials_won','ground_duels_won','fouls','was_fouled','errors_led_to_goal','goals_conceded','saves_inside_box','dive_saves','sweeper_actions','high_claims','punches','xgot_faced','distance_covered','top_speed','sprints','running_distance','sprinting_distance','fantasy_points','passes_attempted','long_balls_attempted','crosses_attempted','ground_duels','aerial_duels','dribbles_attempted','starter','stats_reliable','is_captain']::name[]
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
  WHERE attrelid='statarena_app.appearances'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped
) THEN json_build_array(r.id,r.player_ref,r.ordinal,r.position_id_type,r.player_id,r.team_id,r.team,r.match_id,r.league_id,r.league,r.country,r.season,r.date,r.role,r.position_id,r.raw_pitch_x,r.raw_pitch_y,r.shirt_number,r.minutes,r.rating,r.goals,r.assists,r.xg,r.npxg,r.xa,r.xgot,r.shots,r.shots_on_target,r.chances_created,r.big_chances_created,r.passes_accurate,r.defensive_actions,r.interceptions,r.tackles,r.recoveries,r.duels_won,r.duels_lost,r.touches,r.touches_box,r.passes_final_third,r.clearances,r.blocks,r.dribbles,r.saves,r.goals_prevented,r.shots_off_target,r.blocked_shots,r.shots_woodwork,r.shot_accuracy,r.big_chances_missed,r.xg_plus_xa,r.long_balls_accurate,r.line_breaking_passes,r.accurate_crosses,r.corners,r.throws,r.offsides,r.dispossessed,r.dribbled_past,r.headed_clearances,r.aerials_won,r.ground_duels_won,r.fouls,r.was_fouled,r.errors_led_to_goal,r.goals_conceded,r.saves_inside_box,r.dive_saves,r.sweeper_actions,r.high_claims,r.punches,r.xgot_faced,r.distance_covered,r.top_speed,r.sprints,r.running_distance,r.sprinting_distance,r.fantasy_points,r.passes_attempted,r.long_balls_attempted,r.crosses_attempted,r.ground_duels,r.aerial_duels,r.dribbles_attempted,r.starter,r.stats_reliable,r.is_captain,r.name,r.image_url,r.extras,r.shirt_number_raw,r.shirt_number_type)
  ELSE row_to_json(r) END),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.*,e.extras FROM page_appearances a LEFT JOIN appearance_extras e ON e.appearance_id=a.id ORDER BY a.match_id,a.ordinal,a.id) r) appearances,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.shots WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal,id) r) shots,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) stats,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_coverage WHERE match_id IN (SELECT id FROM page)) r) cover,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT match_id,appearance_id FROM statarena_app.match_appearance_members WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) players,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_warnings WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY ordinal) r) warnings,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.metric_key AS key,m.label,m.unit,m.decimals FROM statarena_app.partition_metrics pm JOIN statarena_app.metric_definitions m USING(metric_key) WHERE pm.season=$1 AND pm.league_id=$2 ORDER BY pm.ordinal) r) metrics,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.*,s.season,s.sample_matches,(SELECT json_agg(native_season ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.competition_catalog_seasons k WHERE k.competition_id=c.id) catalog_seasons FROM statarena_app.competitions c JOIN statarena_app.competition_seasons s ON s.competition_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$2 AND s.season=$1) r) competitions,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT s.team_id AS id,s.name,s.image_url,s.sample_matches,t.country FROM statarena_app.team_seasons s JOIN statarena_app.teams t ON s.team_id=t.id WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2 ORDER BY s.team_id) r) teams,
 (SELECT json_object_agg(metric_key,value) FROM statarena_app.partition_counts WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) counts,
 (SELECT json_agg(note ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.partition_notes WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) notes FROM (SELECT p.*,source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM statarena_app.partitions p WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) s

WITH candidates AS (
 (SELECT f.id,f.day FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.season=$1 AND f.league_id=$2  ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))
 UNION ALL (SELECT m.id,m.day FROM statarena_app.matches m WHERE m.season=$1 AND m.league_id=$2 
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.fixtures f WHERE f.id=m.id AND f.season=m.season AND f.league_id=m.league_id)
 ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id LIMIT ($3::int+1))),
 keys AS (SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT ($3::int+1)), page AS (SELECT id FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id LIMIT $3),
 page_appearances AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT a.*,p.name,p.image_url,s.value_text AS shirt_number_raw,s.value_type AS shirt_number_type
 FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.players p ON p.id=a.player_ref
 LEFT JOIN statarena_app.appearance_shirt_numbers s ON s.appearance_id=a.id
 WHERE a.match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page)),
 appearance_extras AS (
 SELECT e.appearance_id,json_object_agg(e.metric_key,e.value ORDER BY e.metric_key) extras
 FROM statarena_app.appearance_metrics e JOIN page_appearances a ON a.id=e.appearance_id GROUP BY e.appearance_id)
 SELECT s.*, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT id,day::text FROM keys ORDER BY day NULLS LAST,id) r) keys,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.* FROM statarena_app.matches m JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY m.day NULLS LAST,m.id) r) matches,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT f.* FROM statarena_app.fixtures f JOIN page USING(id) ORDER BY f.day NULLS LAST,f.id) r) fixtures,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(CASE WHEN (
  SELECT array_agg(attname ORDER BY attnum) = ARRAY['id','player_ref','ordinal','position_id_type','player_id','team_id','team','match_id','league_id','league','country','season','date','role','position_id','raw_pitch_x','raw_pitch_y','shirt_number','minutes','rating','goals','assists','xg','npxg','xa','xgot','shots','shots_on_target','chances_created','big_chances_created','passes_accurate','defensive_actions','interceptions','tackles','recoveries','duels_won','duels_lost','touches','touches_box','passes_final_third','clearances','blocks','dribbles','saves','goals_prevented','shots_off_target','blocked_shots','shots_woodwork','shot_accuracy','big_chances_missed','xg_plus_xa','long_balls_accurate','line_breaking_passes','accurate_crosses','corners','throws','offsides','dispossessed','dribbled_past','headed_clearances','aerials_won','ground_duels_won','fouls','was_fouled','errors_led_to_goal','goals_conceded','saves_inside_box','dive_saves','sweeper_actions','high_claims','punches','xgot_faced','distance_covered','top_speed','sprints','running_distance','sprinting_distance','fantasy_points','passes_attempted','long_balls_attempted','crosses_attempted','ground_duels','aerial_duels','dribbles_attempted','starter','stats_reliable','is_captain']::name[]
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute
  WHERE attrelid='statarena_app.appearances'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped
) THEN json_build_array(r.id,r.player_ref,r.ordinal,r.position_id_type,r.player_id,r.team_id,r.team,r.match_id,r.league_id,r.league,r.country,r.season,r.date,r.role,r.position_id,r.raw_pitch_x,r.raw_pitch_y,r.shirt_number,r.minutes,r.rating,r.goals,r.assists,r.xg,r.npxg,r.xa,r.xgot,r.shots,r.shots_on_target,r.chances_created,r.big_chances_created,r.passes_accurate,r.defensive_actions,r.interceptions,r.tackles,r.recoveries,r.duels_won,r.duels_lost,r.touches,r.touches_box,r.passes_final_third,r.clearances,r.blocks,r.dribbles,r.saves,r.goals_prevented,r.shots_off_target,r.blocked_shots,r.shots_woodwork,r.shot_accuracy,r.big_chances_missed,r.xg_plus_xa,r.long_balls_accurate,r.line_breaking_passes,r.accurate_crosses,r.corners,r.throws,r.offsides,r.dispossessed,r.dribbled_past,r.headed_clearances,r.aerials_won,r.ground_duels_won,r.fouls,r.was_fouled,r.errors_led_to_goal,r.goals_conceded,r.saves_inside_box,r.dive_saves,r.sweeper_actions,r.high_claims,r.punches,r.xgot_faced,r.distance_covered,r.top_speed,r.sprints,r.running_distance,r.sprinting_distance,r.fantasy_points,r.passes_attempted,r.long_balls_attempted,r.crosses_attempted,r.ground_duels,r.aerial_duels,r.dribbles_attempted,r.starter,r.stats_reliable,r.is_captain,r.name,r.image_url,r.extras,r.shirt_number_raw,r.shirt_number_type)
  ELSE row_to_json(r) END),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.*,e.extras FROM page_appearances a LEFT JOIN appearance_extras e ON e.appearance_id=a.id ORDER BY a.match_id,a.ordinal,a.id) r) appearances,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.shots WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal,id) r) shots,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) stats,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_coverage WHERE match_id IN (SELECT id FROM page)) r) cover,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT match_id,appearance_id FROM statarena_app.match_appearance_members WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY match_id,ordinal) r) players,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_warnings WHERE match_id IN(SELECT id FROM page) ORDER BY ordinal) r) warnings,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT m.metric_key AS key,m.label,m.unit,m.decimals FROM statarena_app.partition_metrics pm JOIN statarena_app.metric_definitions m USING(metric_key) WHERE pm.season=$1 AND pm.league_id=$2 ORDER BY pm.ordinal) r) metrics,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT c.*,s.season,s.sample_matches,(SELECT json_agg(native_season ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.competition_catalog_seasons k WHERE k.competition_id=c.id) catalog_seasons FROM statarena_app.competitions c JOIN statarena_app.competition_seasons s ON s.competition_id=c.id WHERE c.id=$2 AND s.season=$1) r) competitions,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT s.team_id AS id,s.name,s.image_url,s.sample_matches,t.country FROM statarena_app.team_seasons s JOIN statarena_app.teams t ON s.team_id=t.id WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2 ORDER BY s.team_id) r) teams,
 (SELECT json_object_agg(metric_key,value) FROM statarena_app.partition_counts WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) counts,
 (SELECT json_agg(note ORDER BY ordinal) FROM statarena_app.partition_notes WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) notes FROM (SELECT p.*,source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM statarena_app.partitions p WHERE season=$1 AND league_id=$2) s

SELECT g.*,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_id AS id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.appearances WHERE player_id=ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY 1,2,3) r) players,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT team_id AS id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.team_seasons WHERE team_id=ANY($2::text[]) UNION SELECT home_team_id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE home_team_id=ANY($2::text[]) UNION SELECT away_team_id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE away_team_id=ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY 1,2,3) r) teams FROM (SELECT generation::text AS version, published_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs) AS dirty FROM statarena_app.publications WHERE singleton) g

SELECT g.*,(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT player_id AS id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.appearances WHERE player_id=ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY 1,2,3) r) players,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT team_id AS id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.team_seasons WHERE team_id=ANY($2::text[]) UNION SELECT home_team_id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE home_team_id=ANY($2::text[]) UNION SELECT away_team_id,season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE away_team_id=ANY($2::text[]) ORDER BY 1,2,3) r) teams FROM (SELECT generation::text AS version, published_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs) AS dirty FROM statarena_app.publications WHERE singleton) g

SELECT p.source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1) AS has_match, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM
 (SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1 UNION SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE id=$1) t
 JOIN statarena_app.partitions p USING(season,league_id) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.*,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1) r) matches,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE id=$1) r) fixtures,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT match_id,id,team_id,player_id,player_name,minute,minute_added,period,xg,is_goal,is_own_goal FROM statarena_app.shots WHERE match_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal,id) r) shots,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id=$1 AND metric_key IN ('expected_goals','total_shots','ShotsOnTarget','BallPossesion','big_chance','corners') ORDER BY ordinal) r) stats,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_coverage WHERE match_id=$1) r) cover,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_warnings WHERE match_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal) r) warnings,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT a.id,a.player_id,a.match_id,a.team_id,a.team,p.name,p.image_url,a.minutes,a.rating,a.goals,a.assists FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.players p ON a.player_ref=p.id WHERE match_id=$1 AND minutes>0 AND rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rating DESC,a.id LIMIT 5) r) leaders
 FROM (SELECT p.source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1) AS has_match, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM
 (SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1 UNION SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE id=$1) t
 JOIN statarena_app.partitions p USING(season,league_id) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT 1) s WHERE s.version=$2

 (SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1 UNION SELECT season,league_id FROM statarena_app.fixtures WHERE id=$1) t
 JOIN statarena_app.partitions p USING(season,league_id) ORDER BY p.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT match_id,id,team_id,player_id,player_name,minute,minute_added,period,xg,is_goal,is_own_goal FROM statarena_app.shots WHERE match_id=$1 ORDER BY ordinal,id) r) shots,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.team_statistics WHERE match_id=$1 AND metric_key IN ('expected_goals','total_shots','ShotsOnTarget','BallPossesion','big_chance','corners') ORDER BY ordinal) r) stats,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r),'[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM statarena_app.match_coverage WHERE match_id=$1) r) cover,

 FROM (SELECT p.source_digest AS version, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.matches WHERE id=$1) AS has_match, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statarena_app.publication_jobs j WHERE j.season=p.season AND j.league_id=p.league_id) dirty FROM

SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.competition_season_revision_id::text edition_revision_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,e.season_key AS season,
 co.id::text competition_id,co.revision_id::text competition_revision_id,
 co.name AS league_name,aliases.keys AS league_keys
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL) LIMIT 1) publication ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
 AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys
 FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=e.competition_id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint)
ORDER BY b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049

/*orion:native-match:build-meta*/
 SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
        b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
        b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
        b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
        b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version
 FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
 JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id
   AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
 WHERE b.id=$1::bigint AND b.status='ready'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p
     WHERE p.build_id=b.id AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
       AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version)
 LIMIT 2

/*orion:archive-publication-meta*/
SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,b.dataset_snapshot_id::text,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text,d.generation::text dg,c.generation::text cg,b.representation_version,
 b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,
 e.season_key season,co.id::text competition_id,co.slug,country.iso3 country,
 coalesce((SELECT min(a.public_key) FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=co.id
   AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted),co.slug) public_competition,
 CASE WHEN octet_length(co.name)<=4096 THEN co.name END name,
 coalesce(octet_length(co.name)>4096,false) oversize
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id AND e.revision_id=b.competition_season_revision_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN football.countries country ON country.id=co.country_id AND country.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (country.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<country.recorded_to_gen) AND country.is_canonical AND NOT country.is_deleted
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint) AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
 AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL))
ORDER BY b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049

/*orion:archive-catalogue-meta*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS b(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,dataset_snapshot_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,season text,public_competition text)),docs AS (
 SELECT x.build_id,x.dg,doc.id document_id,doc.content_sha256,doc.source_id,ds.id dataset_id,
  src.name source_name,ds.source_url,ds.license_code
 FROM x JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshot_documents sd ON sd.snapshot_id=x.dataset_snapshot_id
 JOIN ingest.source_documents doc ON doc.id=sd.document_id
 JOIN ingest.source_datasets ds ON ds.id=doc.dataset_id AND ds.source_id=doc.source_id
 JOIN ingest.sources src ON src.id=doc.source_id
 WHERE ds.contract_version=$2::text AND ds.dataset_key=$3::text||':'||x.public_competition||':'||x.season
),matches AS (
 SELECT x.build_id,x.dg,x.cg,x.edition_id,m.id match_id,m.revision_id match_revision_id,m.match_date,m.kickoff_at,m.status,m.round_label,m.round_number,m.neutral_venue,
  s.home_team_id,s.away_team_id,s.home_label,s.away_label,s.home_goals,s.away_goals,s.score_scope,
  (SELECT min(a.public_key) FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='match'
 AND a.match_id=m.id AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) public_id
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
  AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.build_id=x.build_id)
),observations AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.build_id,o.source_record_id) d.build_id,o.*
 FROM docs d JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.document_id=d.document_id AND r.source_id=d.source_id
 JOIN football.match_observation_details o ON o.source_record_id=r.id AND o.recorded_from_gen<=d.dg
 ORDER BY d.build_id,o.source_record_id,o.recorded_from_gen DESC
), result_rows AS (
 SELECT m.*,o.source_record_id,o.source_match_key,o.source_competition_label,o.source_season_label,o.source_home_label,o.source_away_label,
  o.source_date_text,o.date_note,o.source_time_text,o.source_round_label,o.source_stage_label,o.source_group_label,
  o.source_venue_label,o.attendance,o.attendance_text,o.result_code,o.notes
 FROM matches m JOIN observations o ON o.build_id=m.build_id AND o.match_id=m.match_id AND o.match_revision_id=m.match_revision_id
 WHERE o.resolution_state='resolved'
)
SELECT x.build_id::text,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM football.matches m WHERE m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted) actual_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM analytics.match_summary s WHERE s.build_id=x.build_id) summary_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM matches m WHERE m.build_id=x.build_id) match_count,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matches m WHERE m.build_id=x.build_id AND m.public_id IS NULL) aliases_ok,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM docs d WHERE d.build_id=x.build_id) document_count,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dataset_id)::int FROM docs d WHERE d.build_id=x.build_id) dataset_count,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',d.document_id::text,'sha',d.content_sha256,'source',d.source_id::text,'dataset',d.dataset_id::text) ORDER BY d.document_id)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM docs dd WHERE dd.build_id=x.build_id ORDER BY dd.document_id LIMIT 10001) d) documents,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',d.source_name,'url',d.source_url,'license',d.license_code) FROM docs d WHERE d.build_id=x.build_id ORDER BY d.document_id LIMIT 1) source
 ,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM observations o WHERE o.build_id=x.build_id) observed_count,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id) results_count,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT r.match_id)::int FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id) unique_results,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id AND r.status IN ('finished','awarded')) played,
 (SELECT count(*)::int FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id AND r.date_note IS NOT NULL) unverified_dates,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id AND coalesce(greatest(octet_length(r.source_competition_label),octet_length(r.source_season_label),octet_length(r.source_match_key),
 octet_length(r.source_home_label),octet_length(r.source_away_label),octet_length(r.source_date_text),octet_length(r.date_note),
 octet_length(r.source_time_text),octet_length(r.source_round_label),octet_length(r.source_stage_label),octet_length(r.source_group_label),
 octet_length(r.source_venue_label),octet_length(r.attendance_text),octet_length(r.result_code),octet_length(r.notes)),0)>4096) oversize,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM result_rows r WHERE r.build_id=x.build_id AND r.result_code='not_played' AND r.status IN ('finished','awarded')) results_ok
 
FROM x WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM docs d WHERE d.build_id=x.build_id) ORDER BY x.build_id

SELECT (SELECT max(generation)::text FROM ingest.dataset_snapshots WHERE status='sealed') AS revision,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p
 JOIN analytics.aggregation_builds b ON b.id=p.build_id AND b.status='ready'
  AND b.competition_season_id=p.competition_season_id AND b.catalog_snapshot_id=p.catalog_snapshot_id
  AND b.representation_version=p.representation_version
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
 JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
 WHERE p.published_to_gen IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS ready

SELECT b.id::text build_id,b.competition_season_id::text edition_id,
 b.dataset_snapshot_id::text dataset_snapshot_id,d.generation::text dataset_generation,
 b.catalog_snapshot_id::text catalog_snapshot_id,c.generation::text catalog_generation,
 b.representation_version,b.code_content_sha256,b.dependencies_sha256,b.environment_sha256,
 b.metrics_contract_version,b.transform_version,b.finished_at,
 e.season_key AS season,co.name AS league_name,aliases.keys AS league_keys,
 totals.matches_count AS match_count
FROM analytics.aggregation_builds b
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots d ON d.id=b.dataset_snapshot_id AND d.status='sealed'
JOIN ingest.dataset_snapshots c ON c.id=b.catalog_snapshot_id AND c.status='sealed'
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM analytics.publication_versions p WHERE p.build_id=b.id
 AND p.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id AND p.catalog_snapshot_id=b.catalog_snapshot_id
 AND p.representation_version=b.representation_version
 AND ($1::bigint IS NOT NULL OR p.published_to_gen IS NULL) LIMIT 1) published ON true
JOIN football.competition_seasons e ON e.id=b.competition_season_id AND e.recorded_from_gen<=d.generation AND (e.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR d.generation<e.recorded_to_gen) AND e.is_canonical AND NOT e.is_deleted
JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=e.competition_id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint)
ORDER BY e.season_key DESC,b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049

/*orion:list*/ WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
 build_id bigint,edition_id bigint,dg bigint,cg bigint,league_id text,league_name text,season text,token text)), records AS (
 SELECT x.*,a.public_key AS public_id,s.match_id::text,s.match_date::text AS day,
 to_char(s.kickoff_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','HH24:MI:SS') AS time_utc,s.status,m.round_label AS round_name,
 NULL::boolean AS has_playoff,s.home_goals,s.away_goals,s.home_shootout_goals,s.away_shootout_goals,
 ht.public_key AS home_id,at.public_key AS away_id,
 hp.candidates AS home_profile_candidates,ap.candidates AS away_profile_candidates,
 CASE WHEN hp.candidates=0 THEN s.home_label ELSE hp.display_name END AS home_name,
 CASE WHEN ap.candidates=0 THEN s.away_label ELSE ap.display_name END AS away_name
 FROM x JOIN analytics.match_summary s ON s.build_id=x.build_id AND s.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 JOIN football.matches m ON m.id=s.match_id AND m.revision_id=s.match_revision_id AND m.competition_season_id=x.edition_id
 AND m.publication_state='published' AND m.recorded_from_gen<=x.dg AND (m.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.dg<m.recorded_to_gen) AND m.is_canonical AND NOT m.is_deleted
 JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases a WHERE a.route_kind='match' AND a.match_id=s.match_id AND a.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted
 AND a.public_key ~ '^m_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$'
 AND (a.match_revision_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM football.matches anchor
 WHERE anchor.id=a.match_id AND anchor.revision_id=a.match_revision_id AND anchor.competition_season_id=x.edition_id))
 AND ($2::text IS NULL OR a.public_key=$2) ORDER BY a.public_key LIMIT 1) a ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT p.display_name,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0
      WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END AS priority
    FROM football.team_profile_versions p WHERE p.team_id=s.home_team_id AND p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
    AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact' AND p.source_id=m.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global' AND p.source_id=m.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL)))
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS candidates,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN min(display_name) END AS display_name
  FROM candidates WHERE priority=(SELECT min(priority) FROM candidates)) hp ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT p.display_name,CASE p.profile_context WHEN 'provider_global' THEN 0
      WHEN 'legacy_normalized_global' THEN 1 WHEN 'global' THEN 2 END AS priority
    FROM football.team_profile_versions p WHERE p.team_id=s.away_team_id AND p.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (p.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<p.recorded_to_gen) AND p.is_canonical AND NOT p.is_deleted
    AND ((p.profile_context='provider_global' AND p.variant_key='provider:exact' AND p.source_id=m.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='legacy_normalized_global' AND p.source_id=m.source_id)
      OR (p.profile_context='global' AND p.provenance_kind='manual' AND p.source_id IS NULL)))
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS candidates,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN min(display_name) END AS display_name
  FROM candidates WHERE priority=(SELECT min(priority) FROM candidates)) ap ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases t WHERE t.route_kind='team' AND t.team_id=s.home_team_id
 AND t.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (t.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<t.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT t.is_deleted AND t.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' ORDER BY t.public_key LIMIT 1) ht ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.public_key FROM ingest.public_aliases t WHERE t.route_kind='team' AND t.team_id=s.away_team_id
 AND t.recorded_from_gen<=x.cg AND (t.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR x.cg<t.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT t.is_deleted AND t.public_key ~ '^t_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' ORDER BY t.public_key LIMIT 1) at ON true)
 SELECT * FROM records r ORDER BY r.day NULLS LAST,r.public_id LIMIT $3

JOIN football.competitions co ON co.id=e.competition_id AND co.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (co.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<co.recorded_to_gen) AND co.is_canonical AND NOT co.is_deleted
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT array_agg(a.public_key ORDER BY a.public_key) keys FROM ingest.public_aliases a
 WHERE a.route_kind='competition' AND a.competition_id=e.competition_id
 AND a.public_key ~ '^l_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$' AND a.recorded_from_gen<=c.generation AND (a.recorded_to_gen IS NULL OR c.generation<a.recorded_to_gen) AND NOT a.is_deleted) aliases ON true
LEFT JOIN analytics.competition_summary totals ON totals.build_id=b.id AND totals.competition_season_id=b.competition_season_id
WHERE b.status='ready' AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR b.id=$1::bigint)
ORDER BY e.season_key DESC,b.competition_season_id,b.id LIMIT 2049
